title: Child's Play
tagline: Andy Barclay has a new playmate who's in no mood to play.
about: A six-year-old gets the Good Guy doll he wanted for his birthday, and it holds the soul of a Chicago strangler who wants out.

Citrus-braised crisp pork and spicy slaw.How to make it1.2kg pork shoulder, cut in 4cm pieces2 oranges, juiced2 limes, juiced4 garlic cloves, crushed1 brown onion, sliced1 tbsp thyme leaves1 habanero chilli, pierced3 tbsp vegetable oil1/4 white cabbage, finely shredded1 carrot, grated250ml white vinegar300g white rice400g tin red kidney beans, drainedToss the pork with the orange and lime juice, garlic, onion, thyme, chilli and salt and leave for 20 minutes.Tip into a pot with water to just cover and simmer until tender and most of the liquid has gone.Mix the cabbage and carrot with the vinegar, a pinch of chilli and salt for the pikliz.Cook the rice with the beans and a pinch of salt.Fry the drained pork in hot oil until crisp at the edges and serve with the rice and pikliz.Good Guy macaroni cheeseAndy wanted a Good Guy so badly.
